# Vietnam Guide

> Objective travel reference for Vietnam. Place pages share one template. Province names changed in 2025; search names such as Hoi An and Ha Giang stayed.

## Notes

Editorial dots are the site's judgment. Visit rank is withheld until a place has 28 days and 500 sessions. Fees and visa rules carry a verified date. The official e-visa portals are https://evisa.gov.vn/ and https://thithucdientu.gov.vn/.
